about: Course spine for the Ground School hub. Chapter titles, order, stage boundaries and video counts come from the Pilot Institute Private Pilot course inventory (factual metadata only; no course content). Every hub experience reads this one file. bench.subjects are Calibration Bench subject names; decks are flashcards deck ids (ld-* ids are browser-stored local decks fed by the bench importer); ppl maps a chapter to a section of the legacy /ppl/ tracker (offset/items index into its stored bit string); onenote is the section name the OneNote builder created.

onenote.note: Section links need the notebook's web URL. Set baseUrl to the section group's URL and the hub appends the section name; until then the hub shows the section name only.

wx.label: Weather Report Drills
wx.blurb: Read raw METARs, TAFs and PIREPs from a real-weather corpus, reveal the decode, or run FAA-style sets.

radio-recall.label: Radio Recall
radio-recall.blurb: Listen, retain, read back: from single digits to full ATC clearances, with a fly-the-plane dual task. Runs locally; not published yet.

chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.blurb: Course orientation: study guide, supplies, how to study, the LMS, the quizbank, the exam.

chapters.title: Introduction to Flight Training
chapters.blurb: The FAA, aircraft classification, certificate levels, choosing a school, Part 61 vs 141, becoming a student pilot, medicals and BasicMed.

chapters.title: Aircraft Structure
chapters.blurb: Wing, empennage, fuselage, landing gear, the four forces, cockpits, axes, primary and secondary controls, trim and tabs.

chapters.title: Aircraft Systems
chapters.blurb: Reciprocating engine, fuel and induction, carburetor icing, ignition and magnetos, oil and cooling, turbo and superchargers, propellers, electrical, hydraulics, pressurization, oxygen, deicing, ELT.

chapters.title: Aircraft Instruments
chapters.blurb: Pitot-static instruments and their errors, types of altitude and airspeed, gyros, vacuum system, EFD, magnetic compass errors.

chapters.title: Basic Aerodynamics
chapters.blurb: The four forces, how lift is created, thrust, parasite and induced drag, wingtip vortices, ground effect.

chapters.title: Aerodynamic Forces
chapters.blurb: Forces in turns, climbs and descents, stalls and spins, load factor, the Vg diagram, stability, turning tendencies, frost.

chapters.title: Weight and Balance
chapters.blurb: Weight and balance control, terms, moment and arm, CG effects, computational, graph and table methods, shifting weight.

chapters.title: Performance & Limitations
chapters.blurb: Pressure and density altitude, climb, range and endurance, takeoff, landing, fuel and TAS charts, crosswind components.

chapters.title: Regulation
chapters.blurb: Part 61 privileges and limitations, medicals and BasicMed, certification, flight review, currency, pilot responsibilities, Part 91 rules.

chapters.title: Inspections and Documents
chapters.blurb: Required documents, inspections (annual, 100-hour, transponder, ELT, pitot-static), ADs, maintenance records, inoperative equipment.

chapters.title: Aeromedical Factors
chapters.blurb: Hypoxia, hyperventilation, carbon monoxide, spatial disorientation, vision and scanning, motion sickness, alcohol and drugs, fitness.

chapters.title: Aeronautical Decision Making
chapters.blurb: The ADM process, hazardous attitudes and antidotes, risk management, PAVE and IMSAFE, situational awareness, SRM.

chapters.title: Weather Theory
chapters.blurb: The atmosphere, pressure and wind, stability, moisture and clouds, fronts, thunderstorms, turbulence, icing, fog.

chapters.title: Weather Services
chapters.blurb: Briefings, METARs, TAFs, PIREPs, AIRMETs and SIGMETs, winds aloft, GFA and prog charts, radar and satellite.

chapters.title: Airport Operations
chapters.blurb: Runway and taxiway markings, signs, lighting, VASI and PAPI, traffic patterns, wind indicators, light gun signals, LAHSO, wake turbulence.

chapters.title: Radio Communications
chapters.blurb: Phraseology and phonetics, towered and non-towered procedures, ATIS and CTAF, transponder codes, emergencies, lost comms.

chapters.title: Airspace
chapters.blurb: Classes A through G, VFR weather minimums, equipment and entry requirements, special use airspace, TFRs, ADS-B.

chapters.title: Charts
chapters.blurb: Sectional chart symbology, airport data, obstacles and MEFs, airspace depiction, the Chart Supplement.

chapters.title: Navigation
chapters.blurb: Pilotage and dead reckoning, true and magnetic courses, wind correction, VOR, GPS and RAIM, ADS-B, radar services.

chapters.title: E6B Flight Computer
chapters.blurb: Using the manual E6B: time, speed, distance, fuel, wind triangle, density altitude.

chapters.title: CX-3 Flight Computer
chapters.blurb: Electronic flight computer walkthrough.

chapters.title: Sporty's Electronic E6B
chapters.blurb: Electronic E6B walkthrough.

chapters.title: Planning a Cross Country
chapters.blurb: Route and checkpoints, the nav log, weather and NOTAMs, fuel planning, weight and balance, performance, the flight plan.

chapters.title: ForeFlight Cross Country Planning
chapters.blurb: Planning the same cross country in an EFB.

chapters.title: FAA Sample Exam
chapters.blurb: The FAA's published Private Pilot Airplane sample set, verbatim: 61 questions, timed, figures from the Airman Knowledge Testing Supplement.
